structure.unit: Standard Nonforfeiture Provisions for Life Insurance

law.catch_line: Inclusion of lapse of time considerations
law.text: Any paid-up annuity, cash surrender or death benefits available at any time, other than on the contract anniversary under any contract with fixed scheduled considerations, shall be calculated with allowance for a lapse of time and the payment of any scheduled considerations beyond the beginning of the contract year in which cessation of payment of considerations under the contract occurs.
